name: UserTesting
description: Get paid to test websites and apps. Share your screen and speak your thoughts aloud. Easy money, no experience needed.
payout_notes: $4-$10 per 20-min test. PayPal weekly.

name: Respondent
description: Participate in research studies and interviews. Higher payouts for professional expertise. Easy side hustle.
payout_notes: $50-$400 per study. PayPal payouts.

name: Testbirds
description: Crowdtesting platform for websites, apps, and IoT devices. Bug hunting and UX testing gigs.
payout_notes: €20-€50 per test. PayPal or bank transfer.

name: ADPList
description: Mentor designers and product people. Build your reputation while giving back to the community.
payout_notes: Free platform. Premium features for paid sessions.

name: Preply
description: Teach English or other languages online. Flexible hours, students worldwide. Great for multilingual South Africans.
payout_notes: $15-$25/hr average. Set your own rates.

name: Italki
description: Language teaching marketplace. Great for native English speakers or multilingual South Africans.
payout_notes: $10-$30/hr typical. PayPal or Payoneer.

name: Time Etc
description: Virtual assistant agency serving entrepreneurs. Part-time and flexible - great for getting started.
payout_notes: $11-$16/hr starting. Experience increases rates.

name: Scale AI
description: Data labeling and AI training tasks. Good for detail-oriented workers who want flexible hours.
payout_notes: $10-$25/hr. Regular payments.

name: Rev
description: Transcription and captioning work. Good for native English speakers who type fast.
payout_notes: $0.30-$1.10 per audio minute. Weekly PayPal.

name: ModSquad
description: Digital engagement company hiring community managers, content moderators, and customer support agents. Flexible remote work.
payout_notes: Hourly rates. Flexible hours.

name: SupportNinja
description: Outsourcing company specializing in customer support, tech support, and back-office roles. Growing fast with lots of openings.
payout_notes: Competitive rates. Full-time positions.

name: Working Solutions
description: On-demand customer service company. Work from home as an independent contractor handling customer calls and support.
payout_notes: Per-minute or per-call rates. Flexible schedule.

name: Teleperformance
description: One of the biggest customer support outsourcing companies globally. Tons of positions, many remote-friendly.
payout_notes: Varies by role and region. Benefits included.

name: Concentrix
description: Global customer experience company. Large scale operations with work-from-home options in many regions.
payout_notes: Competitive rates. Full benefits.

name: TTEC
description: Customer experience technology company. Remote customer service and tech support roles available.
payout_notes: Hourly pay plus benefits. Training provided.

name: Foundever
description: Major customer experience company (formerly Sitel + Sykes). Work-from-home support roles with big brand clients.
payout_notes: Competitive rates. Benefits included.

name: Somewhere
description: Places global talent into US companies. Quality placements, fair USD pay, perfect for SA professionals.
payout_notes: Monthly salary via Deel or direct deposit. USD rates.

name: JobRack
description: Specializes in offshore support and ops staff. Good for getting your foot in the door with European companies looking for reliable remote talent.
payout_notes: Competitive rates. Regular payments.

name: Braintrust
description: User-owned talent network where you hire directly with clients. No middleman fees means you keep 100% of what clients pay. Lekker deal.
payout_notes: Direct client payments. No platform fees.

name: Outsourcely
description: Platform focused on long-term remote staff positions. Good for finding stable, ongoing work rather than one-off gigs.
payout_notes: Varies by employer. Long-term positions.

name: Remote Rocketship
description: Curated remote job board with quality listings. Filters out the noise so you only see legit remote opportunities.
payout_notes: Varies by employer. Direct company applications.

name: Malt
description: European freelance marketplace for freelance and contract work. Quality clients and projects, expanding globally.
payout_notes: 10% platform fee. Secure payments.

name: Codementor
description: Help developers learn to code through 1-on-1 mentoring sessions. Set your own rates and schedule.
payout_notes: $60-$150/hr typical. PayPal or Payoneer.

name: Belay
description: Virtual assistant and bookkeeping services for US businesses. Contract-based work for admin pros.
payout_notes: Competitive hourly rates. Direct deposit.

name: Outlier
description: Train AI models by providing feedback and creating training data. Good rates for specialists in various fields.
payout_notes: $15-$50/hr depending on expertise. Weekly PayPal.

name: Contra
description: Commission-free freelance platform. Keep 100% of what you earn - no dodgy fees.
payout_notes: No platform fees. Direct client payments.

name: We Work Remotely
description: Largest remote work community. Quality job listings, many SA-friendly positions.
payout_notes: Varies by employer. Many offer competitive global rates.

name: Lemon.io
description: Developer marketplace originally focused on Eastern Europe but accepting global talent including SA devs.
payout_notes: $25-$100/hr. Bi-weekly payments.

name: Support Driven Jobs
description: Curated job board for customer support professionals. Quality remote support positions.
payout_notes: Varies by company. Many offer competitive global rates.

name: RecruitCRM
description: Hiring platform for recruitment agencies that also hires remote talent globally for their own operations.
payout_notes: Monthly salary. Competitive international rates.

name: Dynamite Jobs
description: Remote job board focused on quality listings from legit companies. Great filter options to find support roles.
payout_notes: Varies by employer. Direct applications.

name: Boldly
description: Premium remote staffing company. They hire experienced executive assistants, marketing specialists, and project managers.
payout_notes: Competitive rates. W2 employment in some regions.

name: Arise
description: Platform connecting service partners with big brands for customer support. You run your own small business essentially.
payout_notes: Varies by client program. Contractor model.

name: LiveWorld
description: Social media customer care and community management. Work with big brands on their social channels.
payout_notes: Competitive rates. Remote positions.

name: The Social Element
description: Social media management agency. They hire community managers and social media specialists to work with global brands.
payout_notes: Competitive rates. Remote-first company.

name: Shopify
description: E-commerce giant with a digital-by-default policy. They hire support advisors, success managers, and more globally.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries. Great benefits.

name: Hotjar
description: Fully remote product analytics company. They hire globally and have a great remote culture.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries. Fully remote.

name: Intercom
description: Customer messaging platform. They hire support specialists and other roles, with remote options available.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries. Tech company benefits.

name: Zendesk
description: Customer service software company. They understand support - great place for support professionals.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries. Good benefits.

name: Freshworks
description: SaaS company with customer service products. They hire support specialists and have a global presence.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries. Benefits included.

name: Kraken
description: Major crypto exchange. Fully remote company with support and ops roles. Crypto-friendly payouts available.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries. Crypto payouts possible.

name: Binance
description: Largest crypto exchange by volume. Remote-first with lots of support and operations roles.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries. Crypto benefits.

name: Coinbase
description: US-based crypto exchange. Remote-first company with customer support and other roles available globally.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries. Crypto benefits.

name: Crossover
description: High-salary remote placements with rigorous cognitive testing. Not for everyone, but if you pass, the pay is lekker.
payout_notes: Weekly pay. R50k+ monthly for skilled roles.

name: Turing
description: AI-powered platform matching developers with US companies. Rigorous vetting but excellent long-term opportunities for devs.
payout_notes: Weekly or bi-weekly USD payments. Top rates for senior devs.

name: Proxify
description: Developer matching agency that connects skilled devs with companies needing remote talent. Good rates if you've got the skills.
payout_notes: Competitive developer rates. Regular payments.

name: Arc.dev
description: Remote dev placements with good vetting that leads to quality matches. Solid option for developers wanting consistent remote work.
payout_notes: Competitive rates. Direct employer payments.

name: Gun.io
description: Contract dev placements for senior developers. Enterprise and startup clients. If you're a senior dev, this is where the big bucks are.
payout_notes: $100-$200/hr for seniors. Weekly payments.

name: Catalant
description: Enterprise project placements for experienced consultants. Big company projects with serious budgets.
payout_notes: Premium consulting rates. Project-based.

name: Business Talent Group
description: Enterprise consulting roles for seasoned professionals. Think McKinsey-level projects but as an independent consultant.
payout_notes: Premium rates. Enterprise clients.

name: Maven
description: Paid expert and advisory roles. Get paid for your expertise through consultations and advisory sessions.
payout_notes: Hourly expert rates. Advisory fees.

name: Toptal
description: Elite freelance network for top 3% of talent. Very selective but premium rates and top-tier clients.
payout_notes: Weekly payments via Payoneer or wire. Premium hourly rates.

name: Doist
description: Makers of Todoist and Twist. Fully remote, async-first culture. Great benefits if you can land a role.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries. Full benefits package.

name: Zapier
description: 100% remote company. Known for excellent culture and competitive pay. Dream company for many.
payout_notes: Competitive salaries based on role. Full benefits.

name: Automattic
description: Company behind WordPress.com. Fully distributed team across 90+ countries. Proper remote-first culture.
payout_notes: Competitive global rates. Open vacation policy.

name: Working Not Working
description: Creative network for designers, directors, and producers. High-end freelance gigs for creative pros.
payout_notes: Premium rates. Direct client negotiations.

name: FreedomJobs
description: First job board in the world offering curated international remote opportunities specifically for South Africans. Focus on UK/US/EU companies hiring SA talent.
payout_notes: Varies by employer. Direct applications to international companies.

name: VirtualStaffSA
description: South Africa's only platform focused exclusively on remote work. Free unlimited job postings for employers, vetted talent pool, and optional Done-For-You recruiting service.
payout_notes: Varies by employer. Many global remote positions.

name: OneForma
description: AI data collection, annotation, translation, and UHRS-style crowd projects. Good for detail-oriented South Africans who want flexible AI training tasks.
payout_notes: $5-$25/hr varies by project. PayPal and Payoneer; payments usually twice a month.

name: RWS TrainAI
description: Remote AI data specialist and language evaluation projects from RWS. South Africa-specific freelance AI roles appear through their TrainAI hiring pages.
payout_notes: $10-$30/hr varies by project. Contractor payments by approved RWS payment setup.

name: Mindrift
description: Freelance AI tutor and expert-rating work. Stronger fit if you can write clearly, judge AI answers, or bring subject-matter expertise.
payout_notes: $15-$100/hr advertised depending on expertise. Bi-weekly payments.

name: Clickworker
description: Microtasks, UHRS tasks, search evaluation, text work, and data projects. Best as side income rather than a full remote salary.
payout_notes: $3-$15/hr typical for available tasks. Weekly payouts via PayPal, Payoneer, AirTM, eWallet, ACH or SEPA where supported.

name: TELUS Digital AI Community
description: AI community roles including search, map, ads, and language-rating projects. Work is assessment-heavy but legitimate when openings match your locale.
payout_notes: $8-$20/hr varies by project and locale. Payments depend on the project contract.

name: 20four7VA
description: Virtual assistant network that explicitly accepts applications from South Africa. Good for admin, customer support, and operations VA work.
payout_notes: $4-$12/hr typical VA range. Client-matched contractor payments.

name: Wing Assistant
description: Remote virtual assistant roles across admin, real estate, sales, and operations. South Africa-specific VA listings appear through remote job boards.
payout_notes: $4-$10/hr typical VA range. Remote contractor payments by role.

name: VAConnect
description: South African virtual assistant agency with pre-screened VA talent. Best for experienced admin, executive assistant, and operations profiles.
payout_notes: ZAR or USD-equivalent VA rates vary by placement. SA-based talent platform.

name: Cherry Assistant
description: Remote assistant staffing company sourcing talent from South Africa and the Philippines. Better fit for VA, admin, sales, and support experience.
payout_notes: $4-$12/hr typical assistant range. Placement-based remote work.

name: 1840 & Company
description: Global staffing marketplace with a South Africa talent page. Covers VAs, data entry, customer support, IT support, and specialist remote roles.
payout_notes: $5-$12/hr typical offshore role range. Payment terms depend on placement.

name: Cambly
description: Conversational English tutoring with flexible hours. Native English speakers from South Africa are commonly eligible when tutor applications are open.
payout_notes: $10.20/hr adult tutoring; Cambly Kids pays more. Weekly PayPal payouts.

name: AmazingTalker
description: Online language tutoring marketplace where tutors set their own rates. Useful for English, Afrikaans, Zulu, or niche subject teaching.
payout_notes: $10-$30/hr typical. Withdraw via Wise, PayPal, or Payoneer.

name: Superprof South Africa
description: Local tutoring marketplace for South Africans teaching school subjects, languages, music, fitness, and skills online or in person.
payout_notes: Set your own ZAR rates. Superprof says tutors pay no commission.

name: Verbling
description: Language teaching platform for tutors with strong fluency or teaching experience. Good for English and multilingual South Africans.
payout_notes: $10-$35/hr typical. Cash out via PayPal, Wise, Payoneer, or Verbling Credit.

name: TutorOcean
description: Online tutoring marketplace with South Africa tutor pages. Best for academic subjects, test prep, and homework help.
payout_notes: $15-$40/hr typical. Platform-managed online tutoring payouts.

name: TranscribeMe
description: Beginner-friendly transcription platform with a public South African freelancer testimonial. Good for fast typists starting with audio work.
payout_notes: $15-$22 per audio hour typical. PayPal payouts after passing the exam.

name: GoTranscript
description: Global transcription and captioning work with frequent language-specific openings. Good fallback when Rev applications are closed.
payout_notes: Up to $0.60 per audio minute. Weekly payouts via PayPal, Payoneer, or USDC.

name: Scribie
description: Short-file transcription marketplace for beginners. Low pay, but simple entry if you have PayPal and want flexible audio snippets.
payout_notes: $5-$20 per audio hour. PayPal only; South Africans can receive PayPal via local withdrawal.

name: Way With Words
description: Transcription jobs from a company with South African roots and global clients. Better for accurate English typing and careful formatting.
payout_notes: $0.40-$1.20 per audio minute advertised. Monthly PayPal payouts.

name: Happy Scribe
description: Freelance transcription and subtitling platform. Openings are competitive, but payments through Wise can work well for South Africans.
payout_notes: Rates vary by language and task. Pays on the 1st and 15th via Wise.

name: Redbubble
description: Upload designs to sell on stickers, shirts, prints, and homeware. Best for designers who can build many niche designs over time.
payout_notes: Royalty margin income. Monthly payouts after $10 threshold; South Africans use PayPal.

name: Shutterstock Contributor
description: Sell stock photos, vectors, illustrations, video, and music. Good for photographers and designers with original content libraries.
payout_notes: Royalties vary by license and level. Payouts via Payoneer, PayPal, or Skrill.

name: Adobe Stock Contributor
description: Sell stock photos, vectors, videos, templates, and AI-assisted assets through Adobe Stock. Strong fit for polished creative portfolios.
payout_notes: Royalties use USD credits. Payoneer is required for South Africa; payout after threshold.

name: Dreamstime Contributor
description: Stock photo and illustration marketplace with a long-running contributor program. Better as a portfolio income stream than quick cash.
payout_notes: Royalties vary. Request payout from $100 via PayPal, Payoneer, Skrill, or check.

name: Pond5 Contributor
description: Sell stock video, music, sound effects, images, and After Effects templates. Strongest for creators with video or audio assets.
payout_notes: Royalties vary. Monthly payouts via PayPal, Payoneer, or Skrill; referral earnings also supported.

name: LaborX
description: Crypto freelance marketplace for development, design, writing, marketing, and admin gigs. Payments can be agreed in stablecoins or major crypto.
payout_notes: $20-$1,000+ per gig. Crypto escrow-style payments in USDC, USDT, DAI, ETH, BNB and more.

name: CryptoTask
description: Decentralized freelance marketplace for crypto, writing, software, and marketing tasks. Better for people comfortable using wallets and escrow.
payout_notes: $20-$500+ per task. Crypto payments through smart-contract escrow.

name: Superteam Earn
description: Solana-focused bounties, grants, and crypto jobs for developers, designers, writers, and community builders. Work is public and competitive.
payout_notes: $50-$5,000+ per bounty or grant. Rewards usually paid in crypto or stablecoins.

name: Gitcoin Bounties
description: Open-source and Web3 bounty work for developers, technical writers, translators, and community contributors. Best if you already know GitHub.
payout_notes: $50-$10,000+ per bounty. Crypto payments vary by funder and bounty terms.

name: Bountycaster
description: Peer-to-peer crypto bounties linked to Farcaster. Tasks can include design, testing, content, dev fixes, and product feedback.
payout_notes: $5-$5,000+ per bounty. Peer-to-peer payouts in USDC, ETH, SOL and other supported tokens.
